name: KingRevision
prompt: The king performs one powerful sword attack to the left: draw the broad straight sword back, swing it forward across the torso into a fully extended low diagonal cut, follow through then return to exactly the start. Crown and face stay consistent. Do not lift the blade out of the canvas. Show the actual cutting stroke, not just raising the weapon. Preserve the native sprite size within the transparent padding; fixed feet and camera, same equipment and palette.

name: KnightCaptainRevision
prompt: The knight captain attacks with the sword: rotate the sword arm back at the shoulder, then swing the entire rigid straight sword in a clear horizontal cutting arc toward the left, ending with the blade fully extended to the left. Follow through, then recover. No pointing, shouting or spellcasting; this is an actual sword cut. Preserve the native sprite size within the transparent padding; fixed feet and camera, same equipment and palette.

name: RoyalSwordsmanRevision
prompt: Make a full sword attack, not just a windup. Draw the sword to the right side of the image, then snap the whole rigid straight blade horizontally all the way toward the LEFT edge of the image. Fully extend the sword arm toward screen LEFT at the hit. A very brief thin slash accent follows the tip. Follow through then return exactly to the starting pose. Fixed camera and planted feet; keep the native body scale, equipment and palette.
